# Haniesta Luxury Handcrafted & Bespoke Rugs

> Haniesta crafts sustainable, artisan-loomed natural jute, pure wool, and handwoven kilim rugs for UK and European homes, featuring free UK delivery, bespoke custom sizing, and plastic-free eco-packaging.

## Primary Commercial Rug Collections
- [Natural Jute Rugs Collection](https://haniesta.com/collections/natural-jute): 100% biodegradable, sustainable plant-fiber area rugs and runners.
- [Bengal Jutes Collection](https://haniesta.com/collections/bengal-jutes): Premium artisan braided and handwoven natural jute rugs.
- [Hand-Knotted Gabbeh Wool Rugs](https://haniesta.com/collections/gabbeh): Traditional artisan-knotted pure wool rugs with plush organic texture.
- [Dhurrie & Kilim Rugs](https://haniesta.com/collections/dhurrie-kilim): Handwoven geometric and reversible flatweave rugs.
- [Living Room Area Rugs](https://haniesta.com/collections/living-room-rugs): Statement large area rugs curated for high-traffic modern living rooms.
- [Hallway Runners](https://haniesta.com/collections/hallway-rugs-runners): Durable, low-profile corridor and hallway runner rugs.
- [Underfloor Heating Compatible Rugs](https://haniesta.com/collections/all): Low thermal resistance (< 1.5 TOG) breathable natural rugs.
- [Bespoke & Custom Sized Rugs](https://haniesta.com/bespoke): Made-to-measure custom dimensions, shapes, and artisan weaves.

## Authoritative E-E-A-T Buying & Care Guides
- [Comprehensive Rug Care Guide](https://haniesta.com/pages/care-guide): Complete maintenance, spot cleaning, and natural fiber protection.
- [UK Room-by-Room Rug Sizing Guide](https://haniesta.com/blogs/what-size-rug-do-i-need-the-complete-uk-room-by-room-size-guide): Sizing formulas, clearances, and placement rules for UK interiors.
- [Rugs for Underfloor Heating UK Guide](https://haniesta.com/blogs/rugs-for-underfloor-heating-uk-what-works-and-what-to-avoid): Thermal TOG ratings, heat transfer efficiency, and fiber recommendations.
- [Rug Trends 2026 Interior Design](https://haniesta.com/blogs/rug-trends-2026-whats-in-and-whats-out): Organic shapes, biophilic textures, and earthy color palettes.
- [Jute Rugs Honest Pros & Cons](https://haniesta.com/blogs/jute-rugs-uk-the-honest-pros-cons): Candid durability, shedding, and maintenance analysis.
- [Handmade vs Machine-Made Comparison](https://haniesta.com/blogs/ruggable-alternative-uk-why-handmade-beats-machine-made): Why natural artisan loomed rugs outlast synthetic washable rugs.
